sections.title: Redirect to the Beacon page
sections.what: Sends visitors from this old address to the Beacon page, using a timed refresh and a script, with a plain link as a fallback.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps old bookmarks working after the feature moved into Beacon.
sections.watch_out: The version string here (20260724c) differs from the one in the Beacon boot code (20260727b), so the two may not match.

summary: A small page that sends visitors from the old Lessons Learnt address to the Beacon page.
purpose: Keeps old links and bookmarks working after the page moved into Beacon.
why: Likely reason: the feature moved into Beacon and this page keeps the old address alive.
how: 1. The page sets a timed meta refresh to the Beacon address. 2. A script also replaces the current page with that address. 3. A plain link is shown in case neither works.
inputs: The visitor's browser request to this address.
outputs: The browser lands on the Beacon page.
risks: The version string in the target address is hardcoded and differs from the one used in the Beacon page itself.
debug: If the redirect loops or lands on an old version, compare the version string here with the one in the Beacon page and the boot routine.
